name: Facet
text: Add a floating, always-visible legend that updates in real time as the user hovers over data points. This keeps the user’s focus on the graph while ensuring they never lose context, which beats a collapsible sidebar for speed and clarity. The trade-off is screen space, but the gain in uninterrupted exploration outweighs it.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating legend that hides controls when data points cluster near the edge risks trapping users in a dead zone—no legend, no context. A better alternative: a sticky legend anchored to the viewport edge, with a toggle to collapse it when space is tight. Settle it with a usability test: measure task completion time with both designs and ask users to rate clarity.

name: Facet
text:
Choose a sticky legend anchored to the left edge of the graph, always visible but collapsible with one click. This keeps context visible without blocking the graph, solving the dead-zone problem while preserving speed and clarity. The trade-off is a small extra click to collapse it, but that’s outweighed by never losing context mid-analysis.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense clusters—controls vanish behind it, forcing pan/zoom to hunt for context. Better: a context-aware tooltip that appears on hover *and* sticks only when the user pauses, then fades if they scroll away. Settle it with a heatmap tracking where users abandon tasks due to legend occlusion.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to hover-triggered, contextual labels for the legend, with a sticky, collapsible anchor on the left edge for users who prefer permanence.

Result: A legend that stays out of the way until needed, then appears instantly on hover or sticks on pause—clear, fast, and space-efficient. Owned by Facet.
